name: walrus-console-mcp
description: MCP server for Walrus Console — ggdrive-style decentralized, Seal-encrypted storage on Walrus + Sui.
long_description: Console is ggdrive-style decentralized storage. This bundle exposes tools to list spaces, manage Seal-encrypted buckets, and upload/download files. All Seal encryption/decryption and Sui signing happens locally using your service private key, which never leaves your machine.

console_api_key.title: Console API Key
console_api_key.description: Your Console API key. Required for all Console API calls.

console_service_private_key.title: Service Private Key
console_service_private_key.description: Sui private key used locally for Seal encryption/decryption and signing. Never sent to any remote server. Required only for upload/download.

console_admin_key.title: Key-Admin Credential
console_admin_key.description: Key-Admin credential (hbradm_…) used by generate_api_key to mint child working keys. Load only on the provisioning host — never alongside a working key on worker hosts.

console_admin_service_private_key.title: Admin Signer Private Key
console_admin_service_private_key.description: Ed25519 seed for the admin signer (suiprivkey1…) that signs the sponsored grant_bucket_access PTB. Treat like a GitHub App private key. Provisioning host only.

console_api_base_url.title: Console API Base URL
console_api_base_url.description: Override the Console API base URL (defaults to the public testnet endpoint).

tools.name: ping_console
tools.description: Check whether required Console credentials are present.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List your Personal and Team spaces.

tools.name: get_storage_usage
tools.description: Get aggregated storage usage for your active Console space.

tools.name: generate_api_key
tools.description: Mint a new Console working API key headlessly using the Key-Admin credential.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Read a local file, encrypt it with Seal, and upload it.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a file, decrypt it, and save it locally.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files inside a specific bucket.

tools.name: get_file_status
tools.description: Check the processing state of an in-flight upload.

tools.name: delete_bucket
tools.description: Permanently delete a bucket and all its files.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a single file from a bucket.
